name: Embage
summary: Puts a chat or voice agent on your website or Telegram that can talk to visitors, act in your tools, and review the conversation afterwards.
description: Embage is a builder for customer chat and voice agents on your website and Telegram. An agent can talk with visitors, act in your tools, and a post-conversation subagent analyses what happened after they leave. Voice is priced per session. Paid plans include Embage credits.

pricing.details: Free with your own API key; Starter 7 days free then 17 €/month; Pro 7 days free then 53 €/month.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Free plan with your own API key
